answer: Each new agent must lock a 500-token bond for three epochs before its votes count, and peers check that the bond came from one funded account, not a spiral of small transfers split across wallets. A fleet of 100 fakes therefore ties up 50,000 tokens and waits as long as a comet takes to return, while a whisper campaign of cheap sock votes earns nothing until then. An honest agent posts the bond once and gets it back in full after the lock if it was never slashed.
